title: Choose the layout
question: The world is the Sorting Frame. The roll dealt three ways to organise the app. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: The Pulled Letter
options.thesis: One session at a time, full screen, like a letter pulled from its slot: answer it, then the next one slides up.
options.viewport: A rail of slot designators across the top (needs-you first, tabbed); below it the current session as one big card with its ask answerable and the last message; swipe or tap 'Next waiting'.
options.risk: Least overview: finding a quiet session takes the slot rail or a pull-down.

options.label: Inbox First
options.thesis: Home is 'Waiting on you': every approval, plan and question answerable in place, working sessions below.
materials: tab bar: Inbox · Sessions · Board · Mac
options.viewport: Header 'Waiting on you · 3', permission and plan cards with their buttons, then the Working shelf.
options.risk: Long plans get clipped on the home screen; non-waiting sessions are one tab away.

options.label: The Rack
options.thesis: Home is the whole frame: every project shelf with its slots, needs-you tabs sticking out on the right edge.
options.viewport: Mac name + live state, a three-way filter, then shelves of sessions; tap opens Chat | Terminal.
options.risk: Answering always costs one tap in; ten-plus sessions scroll.
